dimensions.evidenceA: Jacob interprets the night encounter as seeing God.
dimensions.evidenceB: John makes the unseen God known through the Son.
dimensions.label: What is claimed

evidence.observation: Jacob said, “I have seen God face to face,” and said his life was preserved.
John says no one has seen God at any time and then speaks of the Son making God known.

record.tension: One witness names a face-to-face encounter; the other denies that anyone has seen God and directs attention to revelation through the Son.
record.title: Can God be seen?
